start.description: The start time of the release as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.

to.description: The upper bound for filtering releases based on the start time as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.

maxResults.description: The maximum number of releases to retrieve. If not set, a default server-defined value will be used.
